title: SGMC资本Mohit：印尼改革需证明实效，重建信心是关键
speaker: Mohit Mipuri

segments.en: The proof is in the pudding now, so to speak.
segments.zh: 可以说，现在要用事实说话。

segments.en: Indonesia and the new chiefs need to show MSCI and international investors that the reforms are not just announcements, but are working in practice.
segments.zh: 印尼和新任领导需要向MSCI和国际投资者表明，改革不仅仅是宣布，而是在实践中发挥作用。

segments.en: That means better transparency around shareholding structures, more reliability, more free float visibility, stronger disclosure standards.
segments.zh: 这意味着股权结构更透明、更可靠、自由流通股更清晰、披露标准更强。

segments.en: MSCI also mentioned they wanted a lot of things in English. So, all these rules just need to be applied consistently.
segments.zh: MSCI还提到他们希望很多内容用英文。所以，所有这些规则都需要一致应用。

segments.en: The other point is policy credibility. Indonesia cannot just rely on these cheap valuations to bring investors back.
segments.zh: 另一点是政策可信度。印尼不能仅仅依靠低廉的估值来吸引投资者回归。

segments.en: It needs to rebuild confidence to fiscal discipline and to consistency in the communication from regulators.
segments.zh: 它需要重建对财政纪律和监管机构沟通一致性的信心。

segments.en: If Indonesia can show progress by November, the conversation can shift from downgrade risk to recovery.
segments.zh: 如果印尼能在11月前展示进展，讨论就可以从降级风险转向复苏。
